info.name: natours
info.description:
Users and Tours run against the Spring Boot API (baseUrl) with Keycloak (keycloakUrl).

1. docker compose up -d   (Keycloak on :9090)
2. ./mvnw spring-boot:run (API on :8080)
3. Run the Users and Tours folders top to bottom (Collection Runner, or Newman:
   npx newman run postman/journeys.postman_collection.json --folder Users --folder Tours --working-dir postman)

Tokens for the seed accounts are fetched and refreshed automatically by the collection pre-request script. Upload requests use postman/sample-image.jpg; in the Postman app set Settings > Working directory to the postman/ folder (or reselect the file).

Reviews, Tours/Reviews and Booking are the original Natours requests and are not ported yet.
